invention.ref: Functional buttons with buttonholes appear in 13th-century Germany
invention.ref_zh: 13 世纪德国出现配合扣眼使用的纽扣

locations.place_label_zh: 巴基斯坦摩亨佐-达罗（装饰性贝壳纽扣）

notes: 「纽扣」的起点取决于定义：摩亨佐-达罗的贝壳纽扣（约前 2000 年，科特迪吉遗址更早至前 2800–2600 年）是装饰品，不是扣件；本条目以 13 世纪德国扣眼的出现作为扣合式纽扣的起点。
summary_zh: 约公元前 2000 年印度河流域已有装饰性贝壳纽扣；真正配合扣眼扣合衣物的纽扣出现在 13 世纪的德国。
summary_en: Ornamental shell buttons existed in the Indus Valley by about 2000 BCE; buttons used with buttonholes to fasten clothing appeared in 13th-century Germany.
summary_ja: 装飾用の貝ボタンは紀元前2000年頃のインダス流域にあった。ボタン穴と組んで衣服を留める使い方は、13世紀のドイツに現れた。

image.alt_en: A pile of brass uniform buttons

notes_en: It depends on the definition. Mohenjo-daro shell buttons (c. 2000 BCE; Kot Diji even earlier, 2800–2600 BCE) were ornaments, not fasteners. This entry dates the fastening button to the 13th-century German buttonhole.
